parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-supplied key that makes a retried POST safe (ADR-0022, ADR-0047). 1-128 printable ASCII characters; **clients must always send one** (missing: `400 idempotency-key-required`; malformed: `400 idempotency-key-invalid`). Generate a fresh UUID per logical submit and reuse it only to retry that same request. The key is global: reusing it with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`. A replayed answer carries `Idempotency-Replayed: true`.
